say:2:1410536001:1.text: Ah, my eyes... That's such a huge light!

say:4:1410536003:1.text: The sun! What a lovely name! It's unbelievable... everything is bathed in light...
say:4:1410536003:1.source_cn: 太阳！好好听的名字！难以置信！整个世界都被照亮了……

choice_prompt:5:1410536003.text: The sun! What a lovely name! It's unbelievable... everything is bathed in light...
choice_prompt:5:1410536003.source_cn: 太阳！好好听的名字！难以置信！整个世界都被照亮了……

say:6:1410536004:1.text: Oh, then I should close my eyes!
say:6:1410536004:1.male: Oh, then I should close my eyes!
say:6:1410536004:1.female: Oh, then I should close my eyes!

say:7:1410536005:1.text: It feels so warm under the sun, much warmer than the magic crystal...
say:7:1410536005:1.source_cn: ……太阳下，竟然这么温暖，比魔法水晶温暖得多……

say:8:1410536006:1.text: But... why isn't it burning us? Her Majesty said it would scorch our skin...
say:8:1410536006:1.source_cn: 可是……这温度，为什么没有烧伤我们？女王陛下明明说这会...

say:9:1410536007:1.text: I told you, she was just trying to trick you! Forget all those warnings, just enjoy everything here!
say:9:1410536007:1.source_cn: 都说了是骗你的！别想那些唬人的说法了，自己好好感受！

choice:5:0:1.text: Don't stare, it'll hurt your eyes!
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 别直视太阳，会伤到眼睛
choice:5:0:1.male: Don't stare, it'll hurt your eyes!
choice:5:0:1.female: Don't stare, it'll hurt your eyes!
